segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we have an elementary level lesson about things that you buy for your kitchen.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们有一个关于你为厨房买的东西的小学课程。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today we are going to buy a lot of machines and devices for our kitchen.
segments.zh: 今天我们将为我们的厨房购买很多机器和设备。

segments.en: So let's jump into the dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以让我们跳进对话。

segments.en: Let's see what we are buying and we'll be back in a bit.
segments.zh: 让我们看看我们在买什么，我们会回来的。

segments.en: I have been looking at this online catalog for over an hour and I still haven't finished getting all the kitchen appliances that we need.
segments.zh: 这个网上商品目录我已经看了一个多小时，还是没挑齐我们需要的厨房电器。

segments.en: What are you getting?
segments.zh: 你打算买什么？

segments.en: Well, the first thing on my list is a new blender.
segments.zh: 好吧，我名单上的第一件事是一个新的搅拌机。

segments.en: I decided to also get a juicer and a new coffee maker.
segments.zh: 我决定还买一个榨汁机和一个新的咖啡机。

segments.en: Don't forget to also get a new mixer.
segments.zh: 别忘了再买一台新的食物搅拌机。

segments.en: I lent the old one to my brother and he broke it.
segments.zh: 我把旧的借给我的兄弟，他把它弄坏了。

segments.en: Yeah, I know.
segments.zh: 对，我知道。

segments.en: I also decided to throw away the old toaster and get a new one.
segments.zh: 我还决定扔掉旧烤面包机，买一台新烤面包机。

segments.en: I am also getting a rice cooker and a steamer to make some nice steamed fish or veggies.
segments.zh: 我还买了一个电饭煲和一个蒸锅来做一些美味的蒸鱼或蔬菜。

segments.en: I'm actually thinking of completely refurnishing the kitchen and getting a new stove, oven, dishwasher and trash compactor.
segments.zh: 我实际上正在考虑彻底翻新厨房并获得一个新的炉灶、烤箱、洗碗机和垃圾压实机。

segments.en: That's a good idea.
segments.zh: 这是个好主意。

segments.en: The kitchen will look amazing.
segments.zh: 厨房会看起来很棒。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So now let's take a look at some of those strange machines on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们来看看一些关于语言外卖的奇怪机器。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: Okay, so the kinds of machines you buy for your kitchen are called kitchen appliances.
segments.zh: 好的，你为厨房购买的机器种类称为厨房电器。

segments.en: Okay, so the word appliance, an appliance is basically a machine or device that is used for the home, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，电器这个词，电器基本上是用于家庭的机器或设备，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So there are many different kinds of appliances.
segments.zh: 所以有很多种不同的电器。

segments.en: You can usually plug these in.
segments.zh: 您通常可以将这些插入。

segments.en: They usually need electricity to work.
segments.zh: 他们通常需要电力才能工作。

segments.en: But the ones we're talking about today are special.
segments.zh: 但我们今天谈论的那些是特别的。

segments.en: They're for the kitchen.
segments.zh: 他们是为了厨房。

segments.en: So that's why we call them kitchen appliances.
segments.zh: 所以这就是为什么我们称它们为厨房电器。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So the kitchen appliances that we are looking at or we're trying to buy is, well, the first one we have is a blender.
segments.zh: 因此，我们正在查看或试图购买的厨房电器是，嗯，我们拥有的第一个是搅拌机。

segments.en: A blender.
segments.zh: 搅拌机。

segments.en: So a blender is a kitchen appliance that you use normally to make drinks.
segments.zh: 所以搅拌机是一种厨房用具，你通常用来制作饮料。

segments.en: So this is a glass jar that is, that's usually on the top of a little machine.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个玻璃罐，它通常在一个小机器的顶部。

segments.en: Now when you put in, for example, some ice and some tea and some lemonade and you can mix it up and you have this special mixed drink.
segments.zh: 现在，当你放入一些冰、一些茶和一些柠檬水时，你可以把它混合起来，你就有了这种特殊的混合饮料。

segments.en: So it's called a blender.
segments.zh: 所以它被称为搅拌机。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So as you mentioned, it's usually used to make some sort of juice or drink.
segments.zh: 正如你所提到的，它通常用于制作某种果汁或饮料。

segments.en: But we also are getting a juicer which is specifically to make juices.
segments.zh: 但我们也有一个榨汁机，专门用于制作果汁。

segments.en: Now what is the difference between a blender and a juicer?
segments.zh: 现在搅拌机和榨汁机有什么区别？

segments.en: Well a blender is a machine that turns the things inside it around.
segments.zh: 搅拌机是一台机器，可以将其中的东西转动。

segments.en: So it mixes them together.
segments.zh: 所以它将它们混合在一起。

segments.en: But a juicer is different because a juicer will actually take the juice from the fruit.
segments.zh: 但是榨汁机是不同的，因为榨汁机实际上会从水果中取出果汁。

segments.en: So for example, if I have an orange and I cut the orange in half, I put that half on the juicer and it turns around so that the juice will come down.
segments.zh: 例如，如果我有一个橙子，我把橙子切成两半，我把一半放在榨汁机上，它会转身，这样果汁就会下降。

segments.en: Because otherwise I have to use my hands to squeeze it and that takes time.
segments.zh: 因为否则我必须用手挤压它，这需要时间。

segments.en: So this is an electronic appliance that helps me get the juice from my fruits.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个电子设备，可以帮助我从水果中获取果汁。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So we have a juicer to make juice, a blender to make different drinks and now to make coffee we have a very simple machine, a coffee maker.
segments.zh: 所以我们有一个榨汁机来制作果汁，一个搅拌器来制作不同的饮料，现在为了制作咖啡，我们有一个非常简单的机器，一个咖啡机。

segments.en: Okay so a coffee maker is just a simple machine that you put water and coffee into and it will make the coffee for you.
segments.zh: 好吧，咖啡机只是一台简单的机器，你可以把水和咖啡放进去，它会为你制作咖啡。

segments.en: Usually it's called a drip coffee maker because the coffee drip, drip, drip, drips down.
segments.zh: 通常它被称为滴水咖啡机，因为咖啡滴水、滴水、滴水、滴水。

segments.en: But there are many different kinds of coffee makers.
segments.zh: 但是有许多不同种类的咖啡机。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Now this next appliance can be a little bit confusing because now this one is called a mixer.
segments.zh: 现在这个下一个设备可能有点混乱，因为现在这个设备被称为混合器。

segments.en: So what is the difference between a blender, a juicer and now we have a mixer?
segments.zh: 那么搅拌机、榨汁机和现在我们有搅拌机有什么区别呢？

segments.en: Well there are different kinds of mixers actually but usually the kind of mixer that we are referring to, that we're talking about is one that is electronic and it looks like it has these two funny spoons on the end.
segments.zh: 好吧，实际上有不同种类的调音台，但通常是我们所指的那种调音台，我们正在谈论的是一种电子设备，它看起来像是这两个有趣的勺子。

segments.en: And when you turn the mixer on, you put it into a bowl and you mix the things in the bowl.
segments.zh: 当你打开搅拌机时，你把它放进碗里，然后把碗里的东西混合起来。

segments.en: So for example, if I want to make pancakes, I put some flour and some water and some eggs into a bowl.
segments.zh: 例如，如果我想做煎饼，我会在碗里放一些面粉、一些水和一些鸡蛋。

segments.en: And I could stir it with my hand, with my spoon, but it's very tiring.
segments.zh: 我可以用手，用勺子搅拌它，但这很累。

segments.en: So there's a mixer that's electronic to turn those ingredients around on its own.
segments.zh: 因此，有一个电子调音台可以自行扭转这些成分。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it's quicker and obviously you don't get as tired.
segments.zh: 所以它更快，显然你不会那么累。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So I think we should take a break.
segments.zh: 所以我认为我们应该休息一下。

segments.en: Let's go back to our dialogue.
segments.zh: 让我们回到我们的对话。

segments.en: Let's check out some more appliances and we'll be back to talk about the rest of them.
segments.zh: 让我们看看更多的设备，我们会回来谈论其余的设备。

segments.en: I have been looking at this online catalog for over an hour and I still haven't finished getting all the kitchen appliances that we need.
segments.zh: 这个网上商品目录我已经看了一个多小时，还是没挑齐我们需要的厨房电器。

segments.en: What are you getting?
segments.zh: 你打算买什么？

segments.en: Well, the first thing on my list is a new blender.
segments.zh: 好吧，我名单上的第一件事是一个新的搅拌机。

segments.en: I decided to also get a juicer and a new coffee maker.
segments.zh: 我决定还买一个榨汁机和一个新的咖啡机。

segments.en: Don't forget to also get a new mixer.
segments.zh: 别忘了再买一台新的食物搅拌机。

segments.en: I lent the old one to my brother and he broke it.
segments.zh: 我把旧的借给我的兄弟，他把它弄坏了。

segments.en: Yeah, I know.
segments.zh: 对，我知道。

segments.en: I also decided to throw away the old toaster and get a new one.
segments.zh: 我还决定扔掉旧烤面包机，买一台新烤面包机。

segments.en: I am also getting a rice cooker and a steamer to make some nice steamed fish or veggies.
segments.zh: 我还买了一个电饭煲和一个蒸锅来做一些美味的蒸鱼或蔬菜。

segments.en: I'm actually thinking of completely refurnishing the kitchen and getting a new stove, oven, dishwasher and trash compactor.
segments.zh: 我实际上正在考虑彻底翻新厨房并获得一个新的炉灶、烤箱、洗碗机和垃圾压实机。

segments.en: That's a good idea.
segments.zh: 这是个好主意。

segments.en: The kitchen will look amazing.
segments.zh: 厨房会看起来很棒。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: Now, let's take a look at more kitchen appliances on Language Takeaway Part 2.
segments.zh: 现在，让我们来看看更多关于语言外卖第二部分的厨房电器。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: Well, this first item, this first appliance is something that I know a lot of people all over the world are familiar with.
segments.zh: 好吧，这第一个项目，第一个设备是我认识的世界上很多人都熟悉的东西。

segments.en: It's called a rice cooker.
segments.zh: 它被称为电饭煲。

segments.en: Now, a rice cooker, as the name says, it is used to cook rice but it does it in a very simple and automatic way.
segments.zh: 现在，一个电饭煲，顾名思义，它是用来煮米饭的，但它是以一种非常简单和自动的方式来做的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: You put the rice in the water in the rice cooker and you turn it on to, what, 20 minutes and then later, 20 minutes later, it's already cooked.
segments.zh: 你把米饭放在电饭煲的水里，然后把它打开，20分钟，然后，20分钟后，它已经煮熟了。

segments.en: It's done.
segments.zh: 完成了。

segments.en: Done.
segments.zh: 好了。

segments.en: Easy.
segments.zh: 简单。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: It's actually very convenient and very simple to make.
segments.zh: 它实际上非常方便且制作简单。

segments.en: Now, along with a rice cooker, sometimes we also get a steamer.
segments.zh: 现在，连同一个电饭煲，有时我们还会得到一个蒸锅。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So a steamer is something that we normally use with vegetables or in Asia, a lot of times we use it with dumplings, these little foods that are stuffed.
segments.zh: 所以蒸锅是我们通常与蔬菜或亚洲一起使用的东西，很多时候我们将它与饺子一起使用，这些小食品被塞满了。

segments.en: And so, a steamer is something that you use to cook a food but with the steam from hot water.
segments.zh: 因此，蒸笼是用来烹饪食物的东西，但使用热水中的蒸汽。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: You don't put the food in the water, you don't fry the food, but you use the steam, that hot air, to cook the food inside.
segments.zh: 你不把食物放在水里，你不炸食物，而是用蒸汽，热空气，把食物煮在里面。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it's actually considered to be some of the, one of the healthiest ways of cooking food because it's not as oily.
segments.zh: 所以它实际上被认为是一些最健康的烹饪方式，因为它没有那么油腻。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Now, an interesting appliance that is actually not very popular in any other place except, I think, North America, is a trash compactor.
segments.zh: 现在，除了我认为北美以外的任何其他地方都不太受欢迎的有趣设备是垃圾压实机。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So, trash means garbage.
segments.zh: 所以，垃圾意味着垃圾。

segments.en: It's the things that you want to throw away that you won't use anymore.
segments.zh: 这是你想扔掉的东西，你不会再使用了。

segments.en: And a compactor is something that actually takes the trash and it makes it very small.
segments.zh: 压实机实际上是把垃圾带走，它使它变得非常小。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Compact means small.
segments.zh: 紧凑意味着小。

segments.en: And so, a trash compactor is like a special garbage bin.
segments.zh: 因此，垃圾压实机就像一个特殊的垃圾箱。

segments.en: You put your garbage in it and you close it and you say, compact, and then it makes a loud noise.
segments.zh: 你把你的垃圾放进去，把它关上，你说，紧凑，然后它会发出很大的噪音。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And then when you pull it out, you open it up, the trash is very, very small.
segments.zh: 然后当你把它拉出来时，你打开它，垃圾非常非常小。

segments.en: Very small.
segments.zh: 很小。

segments.en: So it's very easy to throw away.
segments.zh: 所以很容易扔掉。

segments.en: So as we said, I've never actually seen this appliance in any other country except the United States and Canada.
segments.zh: 正如我们所说，我从未在美国和加拿大以外的任何其他国家看到过这种设备。

segments.en: I don't think I have either, but it's pretty popular in American homes because it helps save space and it's very easy to throw things away that way.
segments.zh: 我认为我也没有，但它在美国家庭中很受欢迎，因为它有助于节省空间，而且很容易以这种方式扔掉东西。

segments.en: Yeah, that's right.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: You can make a little bundle of trash and it's much easier than throwing a big bag of trash away.
segments.zh: 你可以做一捆垃圾，这比把一大袋垃圾扔掉要容易得多。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And well, we're doing all this because we are kind of refurnishing the kitchen.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们正在做这一切，因为我们正在翻新厨房。

segments.en: We are giving it new furniture.
segments.zh: 我们正在给它新的家具。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we want to change the appearance.
segments.zh: 所以我们想改变外观。

segments.en: And to do this, we will refurnish.
segments.zh: 为此，我们将重新装修。

segments.en: So to furnish something means to put furniture in it to make it look nice.
segments.zh: 所以装修东西意味着把家具放在里面，让它看起来不错。

segments.en: To refurnish means to change the furniture because we already have some, but we don't like it.
segments.zh: 翻新意味着要更换家具，因为我们已经有了一些，但我们不喜欢它。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And so you can do this with your whole house.
segments.zh: 所以你可以用你的整个房子来做到这一点。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So maybe you throw away the old couch and the table and the kitchen cabinets and you put a new one.
segments.zh: 所以也许你扔掉了旧沙发、桌子和厨柜，然后放了一张新沙发。

segments.en: So you are refurnishing your home, refurnishing the kitchen.
segments.zh: 所以你正在翻新你的家，翻新厨房。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: To refurnish.
segments.zh: 重新装修。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So a lot of great vocab here.
segments.zh: 所以这里有很多很棒的词汇。

segments.en: I think this is very useful for the kitchen, especially if sometimes you don't really know what appliance you need to buy or what the instructions of a recipe say.
segments.zh: 我认为这对厨房非常有用，特别是如果您有时并不真正知道您需要购买什么设备或食谱的说明说什么。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to the dialogue again and we'll be back in a bit.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不再听一次对话，我们会回来的。

segments.en: I have been looking at this online catalog for over an hour and I still haven't finished getting all the kitchen appliances that we need.
segments.zh: 这个网上商品目录我已经看了一个多小时，还是没挑齐我们需要的厨房电器。

segments.en: What are you getting?
segments.zh: 你打算买什么？

segments.en: Well, the first thing on my list is a new blender.
segments.zh: 好吧，我名单上的第一件事是一个新的搅拌机。

segments.en: I decided to also get a juicer and a new coffee maker.
segments.zh: 我决定还买一个榨汁机和一个新的咖啡机。

segments.en: Don't forget to also get a new mixer.
segments.zh: 别忘了再买一台新的食物搅拌机。

segments.en: I lent the old one to my brother and he broke it.
segments.zh: 我把旧的借给我的兄弟，他把它弄坏了。

segments.en: Yeah, I know.
segments.zh: 对，我知道。

segments.en: I also decided to throw away the old toaster and get a new one.
segments.zh: 我还决定扔掉旧烤面包机，买一台新烤面包机。

segments.en: I am also getting a rice cooker and a steamer to make some nice steamed fish or veggies.
segments.zh: 我还买了一个电饭煲和一个蒸锅来做一些美味的蒸鱼或蔬菜。

segments.en: I'm actually thinking of completely refurnishing the kitchen and getting a new stove, oven, dishwasher and trash compactor.
segments.zh: 我实际上正在考虑彻底翻新厨房并获得一个新的炉灶、烤箱、洗碗机和垃圾压实机。

segments.en: That's a good idea.
segments.zh: 这是个好主意。

segments.en: The kitchen will look amazing.
segments.zh: 厨房会看起来很棒。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: Now another appliance that I think is also not very popular in other countries, apart from the trash compactor, we saw in the dialogue a dishwasher.
segments.zh: 现在我认为另一个在其他国家也不太受欢迎的设备，除了垃圾压实机，我们在对话中看到了一个洗碗机。

segments.en: A dishwasher, that's right.
segments.zh: 洗碗机，没错。

segments.en: So this is something that you find in many American homes.
segments.zh: 所以这是你在许多美国家庭中找到的东西。

segments.en: So why do you think trash compactors and dishwashers are not so popular in other places?
segments.zh: 那么，为什么您认为垃圾压实机和洗碗机在其他地方不那么受欢迎呢？

segments.en: I'm not sure.
segments.zh: 我不确定。

segments.en: It's possible it's because they're not very energy efficient.
segments.zh: 有可能是因为它们不是很节能。

segments.en: I'm not really sure.
segments.zh: 我不太确定。

segments.en: I never had a trash compactor in my home in America, but we always had a dishwasher and a dishwasher.
segments.zh: 我家在美国的家里从来没有垃圾压实机，但我们总是有洗碗机和洗碗机。

segments.en: This was very, very nice to have because you don't have to wash the dishes by yourself.
segments.zh: 这非常非常好，因为您不必自己洗碗。

segments.en: You put them in the machine and the machine washes them.
segments.zh: 你把它们放在机器里，机器就洗它们。

segments.en: But you have to do some work before you put the dishes in the dishwasher, right?
segments.zh: 但是在将盘子放入洗碗机之前，您必须做一些工作，对吧？

segments.en: You have to put them in the sink and water for a while and then you take them out and then you put it in the dishwasher, right?
segments.zh: 你必须把它们放在水槽和水里一会儿，然后把它们拿出来，然后把它放在洗碗机里，对吧？

segments.en: No, what we usually did is if there was food on the plate, we'd take the food and we'd put it in the trash.
segments.zh: 不，我们通常会做的是，如果盘子上有食物，我们会拿走食物，然后把它放在垃圾桶里。

segments.en: And if it's, you know, sometimes you leave the plate for like a day or two and it's very dirty, you put some water on it because otherwise it will be hard and it will never come off.
segments.zh: 如果是，你知道，有时你会离开盘子一两天，而且很脏，你在上面放了一些水，否则它会很硬，永远不会脱落。

segments.en: But if it's recently used, you put all the plates, all of the cups, all of the knives and forks into the dishwasher and it uses hot water and some soap and it will wash those dishes in about 30 minutes.
segments.zh: 但如果它最近使用过，你把所有的盘子、所有的杯子、所有的刀叉放进洗碗机里，它会用热水和一些肥皂，它会在大约 30 分钟内清洗这些盘子。

segments.en: So how well does it wash?
segments.zh: 那么它洗得有多好？

segments.en: It washes very, very well.
segments.zh: 它洗得非常非常好。

segments.en: Some work better than others, but of course, if you have food that's two days old on a plate, then it won't wash very well.
segments.zh: 有些人比其他人更有效，但当然，如果你的盘子里有两天的食物，那么它就不会很好地洗涤。

segments.en: I think it also has to do with the type of instruments that people use around the world to cook.
segments.zh: 我认为这也与世界各地人们使用的工具类型有关。

segments.en: For example, big pots.
segments.zh: 例如，大锅。

segments.en: I don't think you can put pots in the dishwasher, right?
segments.zh: 我不认为你可以在洗碗机里放锅，对吧？

segments.en: No, you can't.
segments.zh: 不，你不能。

segments.en: You could not put a wok in the dishwasher.
segments.zh: 你不能在洗碗机里放一个锅。

segments.en: But I think it also has to do with the fact that dishwashers are very big.
segments.zh: 但我认为这也与洗碗机非常大的事实有关。

segments.en: And if you have a small apartment or like me, a very small kitchen, it's impossible to make room for a dishwasher.
segments.zh: 如果你有一间小公寓或像我一样，一个非常小的厨房，就不可能为洗碗机腾出空间。

segments.en: But it seems like a very convenient thing.
segments.zh: 但这似乎是一件非常方便的事情。

segments.en: And of course, there are so many other kitchen appliances that, well, if we started to mention all of them, we would run out of time.
segments.zh: 当然，还有很多其他的厨房用具，如果我们开始提到所有这些电器，我们就会没时间了。

segments.en: But if you have any questions or any comments about this lesson or you have maybe some other kitchen appliances, you can come to our website EnglishPod.com and leave those there.
segments.zh: 但是，如果您对本课程有任何疑问或意见，或者您可能有其他一些厨房用具，您可以访问我们的网站 englishpod.com 并将其留在那里。

segments.en: We hope to see you at EnglishPod and until next time.
segments.zh: 我们希望在 Englishpod 和下一次见到你。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Good.
segments.zh: 很好。
